study.title: EDM-UNet: An Edge-Enhanced and Attention-Guided Model for UAV-Based Weed Segmentation in Soybean Fields
study.short_title: EDM-UNet (ResNet50+ECA+Canny edge guide) soybean weed seg

segmentation.domain: binary weed segmentation in soybean fields from UAV RGB imagery (weed vs background), with edge guidance and structure-prior post-processing
models_tested: EDM-UNet (ResNet50-UNet + ECA attention in skip connections + Canny edge guidance in decoder + Gabor direction-consistency filtering + morphological aspect-ratio filtering)
segmentation.best_model: EDM-UNet: MIoU 0.8945, Recall 0.9353, Precision 0.9478, 40.36 FPS, 43.942 M params, 184.257 GFLOPs

dataset.name: Self-built soybean-field weed dataset, Anda, Suihua City, Heilongjiang, China (Agricultural Science Park of Heilongjiang Bayi Agricultural University)
dataset.note: Acquired 12-20 June 2024, 10:00-13:00, soybean V2-V3; DJI Phantom 3P (1/2.3-inch CMOS 12.4 MP, f/2.8, nadir), 2-5 m above canopy, 80% forward / 70% side overlap (Pix4Dcapture). 800 raw images, LabelMe binary annotation (weed vs background; 11,403 weed instances, 3-48 per image); 8:1:1 image-level split with augmentation on train only: 1040 train / 80 val / 80 test.

segmentation.backbone: ResNet50 encoder + U-Net decoder; ECA (Conv1D channel attention, dynamic kernel) on skip connections; Canny/Sobel edge maps concatenated at decoder stages

mIoU.quote: The experimental results show that the EDM-UNet method achieves the best performance effect on the self-built dataset, and the MIoU, Recall and Precision on the test set reach 89.45%, 93.53% and 94.78% respectively.
mIoU.ambiguity: Binary weed/background; MIoU averaged over all classes incl. background (Eq. 7). Ablation (Table 2, test 8, all modules): MIoU 89.45%, Recall 93.53%, Precision 94.78%, FPS 40.36. Baselines: ResNet50-UNet 82.74%, DeepLabv3+ 81.83%, U-Net 82.09%, PSPNet 70.87%.

mPA.ambiguity: Per-class precision/recall not reported; only weed-class precision/recall as target.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Only MIoU/Recall/Precision for the weed (positive) class reported; no class-pair F1.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Segmentation is weed vs background (no crop class).

edge.framework: PyTorch 1.10, Ubuntu 20.04, CUDA 11.3/CUDNN 8.2.0; SGD lr 0.01 momentum 0.937, cosine annealing (decay 0.0005), batch 16, 300 epochs; GPU NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti 12G; FPS = mean of 100 forward passes

fps.quote: FPS is introduced as an indicator to measure the processing speed of the semantic segmentation network ... EDM-UNet  ... FPS 40.36
fps.section: 3.2 Model Evaluation Index / 3.5 Detection Model Comparison Test
fps.ambiguity: 40.36 FPS measured on DESKTOP NVIDIA RTX 3080 Ti in PyTorch (not an edge device). Authors claim it 'sufficiently satisfies real-time deployment requirements in UAV-based precision agriculture' but no on-board/embedded benchmark.

params_M.quote: EDM-UNet has 43.942 million parameters and 184.257 GFLOPs, while the baseline has 43.933 million parameters and 184.100 GFLOPs.
params_M.ambiguity: 43.942 M params (near baseline ResNet50-UNet 43.933 M; DeepLabv3+ 5.813 M, PSPNet 2.376 M reported for reference).

gflops.quote: EDM-UNet has 43.942 million parameters and 184.257 GFLOPs
gflops.ambiguity: 184.257 GFLOPs per forward pass (FLOPs in billions, Eq./Table 3); vs ResNet50-UNet 184.100, U-Net 451.672, DeepLabv3+ 52.867, PSPNet 6.031.

issues: FPS measured on desktop RTX 3080 Ti (PyTorch, 100 forward passes), not an embedded/edge device; edge.reported=false despite real-time and UAV-integration claims.
Flight altitude 2-5 m above canopy; GSD not explicitly reported (resolution_gsp_m null).
Per-class semantics are weed vs background only; crop class not segmented.
Confusion-matrix discussion (weeds correct 87% post-enhancement vs 76% baseline) consistent with reported Recall.
